pipeline_position: neuromorphic or static inputs → mixed-time-step-trained staged SNN → predictions on stepped or event-driven hardware
abstract_basis: Mixed Time-step Training randomizes time steps across SNN stages and is evaluated on N-MNIST and CIFAR10-DVS as well as time-stepped and fully event-driven platforms.

pipeline_position: input spikes → spiking experts and spike router → Spiking Transformer prediction
task_application: classification on neuromorphic and static datasets
abstract_basis: SEMM makes both experts and router emit spike sequences and adds expert-mixture attention and perceptron blocks to a Spiking Transformer. The abstract names only generic neuromorphic and static datasets.

pipeline_position: biological neural recordings → optimized spatiotemporal filters → recurring spike-sequence patterns
abstract_basis: convSeq detects recurring patterns in recorded biological neural spike data. It neither uses an event camera nor claims spiking-neuron computation.

pipeline_position: task data → activity-guided prune-and-regenerate training → compact deep SNN → predictions
abstract_basis: The proposed SCA framework prunes and regenerates convolutional kernels according to spiking activity during training to reduce inference cost. No event-camera input is stated.

pipeline_position: paired event and RAW measurements → event-guided ISP → RGB image
abstract_basis: The work supplies a pixel-aligned event-RAW dataset and a simple event-guided ISP benchmark method. No SNN or spiking-neuron computation is described.

pipeline_position: conventional video → on-the-fly event voxel simulation → nonspiking reconstruction or optical-flow model
abstract_basis: V2V converts video directly to event-based voxel grids and scales training data without storing event streams. The evaluated architectures are not identified as SNNs.

pipeline_position: event-camera measurements under varying light → photometric reconstruction → surface normals and reflectance
abstract_basis: EventPSR uses an event camera to recover surface normal and material reflectance with a geometric imaging approach. The abstract does not describe an SNN.

pipeline_position: event-camera normal flow → coarse linear fit → nonlinear spatiotemporal registration → time to collision
abstract_basis: The method performs coarse-to-fine geometric model fitting directly on event-camera data for time-to-collision estimation. Its solvers are not SNNs.

pipeline_position: event stream plus visual prompt → SEAL segmentation and open-vocabulary classification → masks
abstract_basis: SEAL performs prompted and generic open-vocabulary segmentation on event-sensor data and curates four benchmarks. No SNN is claimed.

pipeline_position: spiked-covariance samples → minimum-norm regression analysis → generalization-risk regimes
abstract_basis: Here spiked refers to a covariance data model used to analyze overfitting phase transitions. It is unrelated to event cameras or spiking neural networks.

pipeline_position: head-mounted fisheye events → LNES event representation and EE3D network → 3D human pose
abstract_basis: EE3D is tailored to LNES-form event streams and includes a head-mounted event-camera prototype plus real and synthetic pose data. The abstract does not identify the network as spiking.

pipeline_position: sequence input → convolutional LMU modules with spiking variant → sequence prediction
abstract_basis: LMUFormer adds convolutional patch and channel modules to a recurrent Legendre Memory Unit and presents a lower-complexity spiking version. Its tasks are speech and other sequence datasets rather than event-camera vision.

pipeline_position: distributed agents and local data → communication-triggered ADMM → shared learned model
abstract_basis: Event-based means that agents communicate only when a trigger fires in distributed optimization. The paper contains neither event-camera sensing nor an SNN.

pipeline_position: stereo frames plus events and edge cues → edge-guided fusion and disparity updates → disparity
abstract_basis: The network fuses image and event-camera features and injects edge cues into disparity estimation. No spiking neural computation is stated.

pipeline_position: event-camera motion cues → event-based blur augmentation → student-teacher adaptation → 2D pose
task_application: 2D human pose estimation under motion blur
abstract_basis: Events are used to generate motion-aware blurred images for unsupervised domain adaptation of a pose model. The contribution is augmentation and adaptation rather than an SNN inference role.

pipeline_position: visual input → STOD direct encoding → SNN classifier → robust prediction
abstract_basis: The paper analyzes gradient temporal collinearity in direct SNN encoding and introduces STOD to improve robustness. No event-camera data or sensor is identified.

pipeline_position: long event streams → adaptive temporal aggregation and sparse attention → multimodal language output
abstract_basis: EventFlash sparsifies spatial and temporal tokens for an event-based MLLM and introduces the EventMind instruction dataset. Sparse processing alone does not establish an SNN.

pipeline_position: ANN or task inputs → SpikePack neuron and optional ANN-to-SNN conversion → SNN predictions on GPU FPGA or SNN accelerator
abstract_basis: SpikePack is a parallel neuron model supporting direct training and near-lossless ANN-to-SNN conversion across hardware. The abstract does not mention event-camera input.

pipeline_position: incoming events → continuous pose state machine plus direct pose branch → fused 3D pose
abstract_basis: E-3DPSM evolves latent pose states with fine-grained event dynamics and fuses them with direct pose predictions. Event-driven here describes the state machine and no SNN is claimed.

pipeline_position: event stream → 3D Gaussian tracker and mapper → camera trajectory and novel views
task_application: pose-free novel-view synthesis and visual odometry
abstract_basis: IncEventGS incrementally tracks camera motion and maps a 3D Gaussian scene from one event camera. It uses a SLAM-style optimizer rather than a stated SNN.

pipeline_position: raw events → adaptive patch-level spatial-temporal windows → detector or tracker
abstract_basis: ASTW partitions event streams with patch-local adaptive windows and is evaluated for detection and tracking alongside a new RGB-event dataset. No SNN is specified.

pipeline_position: rough stochastic signals → Event-SDE stochastic spiking network → generated spike trajectories
task_application: generative modeling of stochastic spike trajectories
abstract_basis: The work formalizes stochastic SNNs as Event SDEs and derives exact pathwise gradients for their training. Event denotes mathematical discontinuities and not an event camera.

pipeline_position: speech input → speech adapters around frozen text LLM → spoken response
abstract_basis: Freeze-Omni connects speech input and output to a frozen textual LLM for low-latency duplex dialogue. It has no event-camera or SNN axis.

pipeline_position: polarity-separated event streams plus text → motion capture and language reasoning → action class
abstract_basis: POKER explicitly models positive and negative event-camera polarities and aligns motion cues with language semantics for action recognition. No SNN is described.

pipeline_position: event-camera stream plus RGB frames → asynchronous GNN and CNN fusion → driving anomaly
abstract_basis: The hybrid network processes event-camera streams with an asynchronous graph neural network and RGB frames with a CNN. Asynchronous graph processing is not presented as an SNN.

pipeline_position: paired RGB and event samples → asymmetric RWKV fusion → pedestrian attributes
abstract_basis: EventPAR provides 100K paired RGB-event samples and the proposed RWKV framework fuses both modalities for attribute recognition. No SNN is stated.

pipeline_position: dynamic software environment → LLM agent actions → verifier-based task score
abstract_basis: Gaia2 uses dynamic and asynchronous events in software environments to benchmark LLM agents. It has no event-camera sensor or SNN computation.

pipeline_position: video frames → pseudo-event equalization modules → dense temporal captions
abstract_basis: Events are semantic intervals in ordinary videos and the method operates on visual frame features. It is unrelated to event cameras and SNNs.

pipeline_position: mobile-device interactions → asynchronous distributed RL collection and training → control agent
abstract_basis: DistRL uses asynchronous distributed data collection to train multimodal control agents. Neither event-camera data nor SNNs are involved.

pipeline_position: photons → time-encoding spike camera → multiscale alignment and refinement → HDR image
abstract_basis: The sensor integrates photons to thresholds and records overflow timing in a spike camera. The protocol distinguishes this sensor from a contrast-change event camera and the reconstruction method is not an SNN.

pipeline_position: recorded biological neural spikes → S4 autoencoder and latent diffusion → synthetic neural activity
abstract_basis: LDNS models recorded cortical spike trains with an autoencoder and latent diffusion model. Biological spiking data are neither event-camera input nor an SNN claim.

pipeline_position: ordinary video clips plus language → spiking detection transformer → temporal segment
abstract_basis: SpikingVTG is an SNN-based multimodal detection transformer with BPTT-free training and teacher representation matching. Its named video grounding benchmarks use video rather than event-camera streams.

pipeline_position: four-dimensional meteorological data → multimodal fusion model → severe-weather forecast and text
abstract_basis: Severe weather events are the prediction target for a meteorological multimodal model and dataset. There is no event camera or SNN.

pipeline_position: task inputs → hybrid rate-and-temporal adversarial perturbation → attacked SNN outputs
abstract_basis: HART analyzes rate and temporal information retained by SNNs and uses both to construct adversarial attacks. The work is cross-cutting robustness evidence and does not identify event-camera input.

pipeline_position: raw event point cloud → hierarchy plus attentive bidirectional LSTM → 6-DOF camera pose
abstract_basis: PEPNet processes raw event-camera point clouds and combines hierarchical spatial features with an LSTM for pose regression. The network is lightweight but not described as spiking.

pipeline_position: frames and asynchronous events → modality graphs and collaborative alignment → detection or depth
abstract_basis: ACGR preserves event sparsity in a graph and asynchronously aligns frame and event modalities for high-rate inference. Graph convolution is not an SNN claim.

pipeline_position: ordinary streaming video → boundary-detecting oracle and captioning listener → dense captions
abstract_basis: Takusen asynchronously coordinates two multimodal agents around semantic event boundaries in regular video. It contains neither event-camera sensing nor SNN computation.

pipeline_position: multi-view images → IF-binarized dynamic/static Gaussian tags → novel views
abstract_basis: The title claims spiking neurons but the abstract describes mask and tagging fields for dynamic-static Gaussian assignment without explaining any spiking-neuron computation. No event camera is mentioned.

pipeline_position: paired RGB and event-camera recordings → benchmark models → human pose and tracks
abstract_basis: EHPT-XC is a paired RGB-event dataset for pose estimation and tracking under low light and motion blur. The abstract offers no SNN method.

pipeline_position: stereo video frames → parallel neural codec and entropy model → compressed stereo stream
abstract_basis: LLSS is a low-latency parallel codec for ordinary stereo video. Low latency and streaming do not imply either event-camera input or an SNN.

pipeline_position: blurred frames plus events → Mamba motion extraction fusion and propagation → deblurred video
abstract_basis: EVDM uses event motion clues and state-space modules for real-world video deblurring and introduces the paired T-RED dataset. Mamba is not a spiking network.

pipeline_position: ordinary video frames plus one anomaly annotation → progressive event mining → anomaly intervals
abstract_basis: The paper calls abnormal temporal intervals events and operates on ordinary video datasets. It has no event-camera or SNN axis.

pipeline_position: chromatic spike-camera stream → physics-guided pretrained diffusion → high-speed color video
abstract_basis: SpikeDiff reconstructs video from a photon-integrating chromatic spike camera using diffusion guidance. A spike camera is not automatically an event camera and the model is not an SNN.

pipeline_position: ANN teacher logits by time step → entropy-regularized temporal distillation → trained SNN
abstract_basis: The method distills ANN logits into an SNN separately across time steps and regularizes entropy to stabilize optimization. This is a training contribution without event-camera specificity.

pipeline_position: intensity-image teacher plus stereo events → cross-sensor distillation → event-only dense disparity
abstract_basis: The framework transfers dense image information into an event branch during training and retains only events for disparity inference. No SNN or spiking neurons are described.

pipeline_position: task data → quantization and spatiotemporal-activity pruning → compact SNN → edge prediction
abstract_basis: QP-SNN combines weight quantization with structured pruning based on spatiotemporal spike activities for edge deployment. It is a compression contribution without stated event-camera input.

pipeline_position: biological neural recordings → masked population model → neural activity and behavior predictions
abstract_basis: MtM learns from single-cell biological spike recordings across animals and brain regions. Neural spike data do not establish either an event camera or a spiking neural network.

pipeline_position: spike features → spatial-temporal pruning within SMixer → efficient SNN prediction
abstract_basis: SMixer adapts an asynchronous-chip-compatible SNN architecture and prunes spatial and temporal spike features to reduce training cost. Event-driven refers to computation rather than event-camera input.

pipeline_position: RGB-D trajectory + spike-camera training labels → MLP/Transformer calibrator → robot control
abstract_basis: SpikePingpong uses spike-based vision and spike-oriented neural calibration but the abstract does not identify a contrast-change event camera or an actual SNN. These missing definitions determine both axes.

pipeline_position: encoded visual input → frequency encoding and evolving leak SNN → noise-robust prediction
abstract_basis: FEEL-SNN develops a robustness theory and modifies input encoding and neuronal leak dynamics to resist noise. The abstract does not mention event-camera data.

pipeline_position: ordinary video frames → object and semantic-event slot aggregation → LLM video reasoning
abstract_basis: Event slots summarize temporal happenings in frame-based video for a language model. They are not event-camera measurements and the network is not spiking.

pipeline_position: low-light image plus event stream → collaborative fusion and illumination-aware filtering → enhanced image
abstract_basis: EIC-LIE filters noisy events using image brightness and fuses event and illumination features. It also contributes a synchronized high-resolution event-image dataset and does not claim an SNN.

pipeline_position: events plus images and text → prompted encoders and triple contrastive alignment → recognition or retrieval
abstract_basis: EventBind models temporal event features and aligns event image and text embeddings for transfer and retrieval. It is a representation-learning framework rather than an SNN.

pipeline_position: event-camera data → patch context mining and self-supervised pretraining → dense prediction features
abstract_basis: The framework pretrains neural networks solely on event-camera data by grouping sparse event-image patches into contexts and supplies a synthetic training dataset. No SNN is stated.

pipeline_position: image input → DSSA multi-stage SpikingResformer → class prediction
abstract_basis: SpikingResformer combines a ResNet-style hierarchy with a proposed spiking self-attention mechanism and reports ImageNet classification. No event-camera input is named.

pipeline_position: remote event-camera stream → temporal proposals and action classifier → behavior intervals
abstract_basis: The system records event-camera data in Antarctica and detects the start and end of penguin behavior with proposals and a classifier. Its low-power sensing benefit is explicit but no SNN is described.

pipeline_position: sequential or neuromorphic inputs → multiplication-free parallel spiking neuron → SNN predictions
abstract_basis: The proposed parallel spiking neuron uses channel-wise convolution sawtooth dilations and bit shifts and is tested on DVS-Lip alongside non-event-camera sequence datasets. Event-camera relevance is benchmark-level rather than method coupling.

pipeline_position: event stream plus recent depth → arbitrary-time intensity and depth reconstruction → 6D object pose track
abstract_basis: EventTrack6D reconstructs dense photometric and geometric cues from sparse event-camera streams and supplies synthetic and real benchmarks. No SNN computation is stated.

pipeline_position: low-resolution spike-camera stream → hierarchical recurrent alignment and fusion → high-resolution video
abstract_basis: Spk2VidNet reconstructs video from photon-integrating spike-camera streams with a conventional recurrent network. Spike camera is not automatically a contrast-change event camera and no SNN is claimed.

pipeline_position: event-camera tokens → scene-adaptive window-token sparsification → Transformer detector → objects
abstract_basis: SAST dynamically sparsifies event-camera tokens and windows for efficient object detection on 1Mpx and Gen1. Sparse Transformer processing is not an SNN.

pipeline_position: multi-task images → MoE-LoRA training and asynchronous task optimization → reparameterized Vision Transformer outputs
abstract_basis: Asynchronous refers to multi-task optimization in an ordinary Vision Transformer. The paper contains neither event-camera input nor SNN computation.

pipeline_position: flashing LEDs plus event RGB LiDAR and IMU data → residual-pose baseline → precise timing and pose
task_application: human motion capture and pose estimation
abstract_basis: FlashCap combines flashing LEDs with event sensing and releases a multimodal millisecond-resolution motion dataset plus a residual-pose baseline. No SNN is described.

pipeline_position: image activations → Hoyer-regularized sparse binary network with SNN portability → visual predictions
abstract_basis: The main BANN framework learns sparse binary activations and is explicitly demonstrated as portable to multi-step SNNs. No event-camera or DVS data are identified.

pipeline_position: ordinary UAV images plus language → asynchronous mapping decision and grounding agents → navigation actions
abstract_basis: APEX is an asynchronous hierarchical embodied-AI agent operating on ordinary visual perception and language. It has neither event-camera input nor an SNN.

pipeline_position: RGB frames plus event streams → event adapter and reliability-aware fusion → depth pose and reconstruction
abstract_basis: EAG3R fuses RGB and event-camera features and uses an event photometric-consistency loss for robust geometry estimation. Its backbone and adapter are not described as spiking.

pipeline_position: blurry multiview images plus events → event-integral constraints and diffusion prior → sharp 3D Gaussian scene
abstract_basis: DiET-GS uses event-stream constraints and a diffusion prior in two-stage 3D Gaussian Splatting training. No SNN computation is claimed.

pipeline_position: static or DVS input → learnable initial membrane potential and temporal loss → SNN prediction
abstract_basis: The work changes SNN membrane initialization and temporal objectives and reports CIFAR10-DVS and N-Caltech101 results. The mechanism is general SNN training and dynamics rather than event-specific coupling.

pipeline_position: low-light image → spiking Retinex Transformer → enhanced image
abstract_basis: Spike-RetinexFormer integrates SNN computation with Retinex theory for image enhancement on standard low-light benchmarks. No event-camera or DVS relationship is visible.

pipeline_position: traffic event-camera streams → benchmark detectors → traffic-participant boxes
abstract_basis: eTraM contributes ten hours of event-camera traffic data and evaluates several detector families. The abstract does not claim that its contribution is an SNN.

pipeline_position: human-motion events → recurrent latent time-implicit field → arbitrary-time 3D poses
abstract_basis: EvHuman predicts a continuous-time human motion field from event-camera streams with a recurrent feed-forward network and introduces a synchronized dataset. No SNN is stated.

pipeline_position: event stream → stem embedding and heat-conduction MoE blocks → detection queries and boxes
abstract_basis: The proposed detector uses event embedding and heat-conduction-inspired MoE blocks and contributes EvDET200K. SNNs are mentioned among prior detector families but the proposed computation is not identified as spiking.

pipeline_position: static or DVS input → temporal logit-gradient calibration → trained SNN prediction
abstract_basis: TMC rescales SNN logit gradients across time steps and reports results on DVSCIFAR10 and N-Caltech101. Its contribution is general temporal calibration rather than an event-specific inference mechanism.

pipeline_position: line-induced event manifolds → sparse geometric solvers and Adam initialization → full-DoF egomotion
abstract_basis: The method derives sparse geometric solvers from event-camera line manifolds to estimate angular and linear velocity. It is an optimization method without spiking-neuron computation.

pipeline_position: ordinary video frames → Bayesian-surprise scoring and RL refinement → surprise-weighted frame samples
abstract_basis: SPIKE is an acronym for a Bayesian-surprise frame-sampling framework in ordinary videos. It uses neither event-camera measurements nor an SNN.

pipeline_position: event-camera search and template streams → DI-LIF spike-driven tracker → target trajectory
abstract_basis: SpikeTrack is a purely spike-driven event-camera tracker with event-oriented sequence training and a DI-LIF neuron that emits spikes at inference. Both axes are explicitly coupled through the tracking pipeline.

pipeline_position: binned biological neural spikes → timing-adapted spiking modules and latent integration → behavioral prediction
abstract_basis: Spikachu is an SNN decoder for binned biological neural recordings and causal behavioral prediction. Biological neural spikes do not constitute an event-camera axis.

pipeline_position: event stream plus point query → motion-guided matching and velocity-aware consistency → continuous point track
abstract_basis: MATE tailors motion guidance and temporal consistency to sparse event-camera data and constructs two simulated event datasets. It does not describe an SNN.

pipeline_position: spike-camera stream → integrate-and-fire sensor model and spike-rendering loss → optimized NeRF and novel views
abstract_basis: SpikeNeRF reconstructs a NeRF from an integrating spike-camera stream. Its IF layer reproduces sensor measurements for a rendering loss rather than forming an SNN inference network, and the paper distinguishes spike and event cameras.

pipeline_position: multiple semantic-event prompts → diffusion and temporal-coherence conditioning → generated video
abstract_basis: MEVG generates ordinary videos containing multiple semantic events. These events are narrative units rather than event-camera measurements and no SNN is involved.

pipeline_position: video frames plus inter-frame events → local curves and streaming global aggregation → dense continuous trajectories
abstract_basis: The framework models sparse event triggers along continuous point trajectories and combines them with video frames for dense tracking. No SNN computation is stated.

pipeline_position: dynamic graph history → delayed spiking neighborhood aggregation → node representation and class
abstract_basis: Delay-DSGN is an SNN graph model with a learnable Gaussian delay kernel for evolving graphs. Its graph events are not event-camera data.

pipeline_position: 3D point cloud → discrepancy attention and spatially-aware spiking neurons → point-cloud prediction
abstract_basis: The hierarchical Spiking Discrepancy Transformer and spatially-aware neuron operate on 3D point clouds. No event-camera or DVS data are mentioned.

pipeline_position: sequential tasks → Hebbian lateral projection of SNN activity traces → protected synaptic updates
abstract_basis: The method realizes orthogonal projection through Hebbian and anti-Hebbian neuronal operations to reduce forgetting in SNNs. It has no stated event-camera relation.

pipeline_position: DVS event sequence → spatial and temporal spiking Transformer modules → object detections
abstract_basis: HsVT explicitly uses SNN spatial and temporal modules for event-camera object detection and contributes a Fall DVS benchmark. The SNN is the end-to-end task network.

pipeline_position: event plus RGBD observations → shared radiance field and temporal optimization → camera track and map
abstract_basis: EN-SLAM jointly optimizes a continuous implicit representation with event and RGBD supervision and introduces simulated and real datasets. Neural implicit modeling is not an SNN.

pipeline_position: static or DVS input → spiking wavelet frequency mixer → SNN prediction
abstract_basis: SWformer is a genuine spiking task network with a wavelet frequency mixer. The full paper evaluates CIFAR10-DVS and several event-camera-derived neuromorphic datasets, while the architecture itself remains general rather than event-specific.

pipeline_position: asynchronous LiDAR or frame-camera features → flow-based BEV alignment → 3D detections
abstract_basis: AsyncBEV handles timing offsets between LiDAR and conventional camera sensors. Asynchrony alone supplies neither an event-camera axis nor SNN computation.

pipeline_position: adversarially perturbed input → threshold guarding and noisy spiking neurons → robust SNN prediction
abstract_basis: TGO moves SNN membrane potentials away from thresholds and adds probabilistic spiking to improve adversarial robustness. No event-camera or DVS evidence is visible.

pipeline_position: ANN and static or DVS data → probabilistic-neuron ANN-to-SNN conversion → SNN prediction
abstract_basis: The work mitigates temporal misalignment in ANN-to-SNN conversion with probabilistic spiking neurons and evaluates CIFAR10-DVS. Event-camera data serve as a benchmark rather than shaping the conversion method.

pipeline_position: event-camera features at multiple scales → spiking fusion detector → object boxes
abstract_basis: SFOD explicitly fuses multi-scale features in an SNN for event-camera object detection and studies event-dataset pretraining and decoding. The SNN is the task network.

pipeline_position: COCO or Gen1 input → multi-scale spiking feature extraction and fusion → object detections
abstract_basis: MSD is a directly trained multi-scale SNN detector evaluated on both COCO and the event-camera Gen1 dataset. The architecture is presented generally rather than as event-specific coupling.

pipeline_position: events plus image-derived depth pseudolabels → calibrated distillation and temporal context → monocular depth
abstract_basis: Distil-E2D transfers dense image-domain depth priors into an event-domain model and integrates past predictions. No SNN or spiking-neuron computation is stated.

pipeline_position: static or DVS input → dendritic bilinear LIF network → prediction
abstract_basis: DLIF adds bilinear dendritic integration to SNN neurons and is tested on DVS-Gesture and DVS-CIFAR10 alongside static datasets. The neuron is general rather than event-camera-specific.

pipeline_position: video frames plus event motion guidance → adapted pretrained video diffusion model → interpolated frames
abstract_basis: The method adapts internet-scale video diffusion priors to event-guided frame interpolation and introduces a real-world dataset. It contains no SNN.

pipeline_position: biological presynaptic spike timing → Hebbian plasticity dynamics → selected high-activity neuron
abstract_basis: The paper analyzes biological spike-timing-dependent Hebbian dynamics as noisy gradient descent. It does not claim an artificial SNN computation pipeline or event-camera data.

pipeline_position: textual asynchronous plans → graph-augmented LLM prompting → plan reasoning answer
abstract_basis: PLaG helps language models reason about parallel and sequential software plans in AsyncHow. Neither event-camera input nor SNN computation is present.

pipeline_position: image or CIFAR10-DVS frames → gradient-sparsity regularized training → robust SNN prediction
abstract_basis: The method regularizes input-gradient sparsity to train robust SNNs. The full paper separately evaluates a 10-timestep SNN on CIFAR10-DVS, making the event-camera connection benchmark-level.

pipeline_position: ordinary videos → event-level video-language model and instruction tuning → temporal answers
abstract_basis: E.T. Bench evaluates semantic events and their timing inside ordinary videos. These are not event-camera measurements and the baseline is not an SNN.

pipeline_position: timed semantic-event captions → temporally conditioned diffusion Transformer → generated video
abstract_basis: MinT controls the order and timing of semantic events in generated ordinary video. It has no event-camera or SNN axis.

pipeline_position: single event-camera stream → event-generation constraints and deformable Gaussians → dynamic 4D scene
abstract_basis: FastEventDGS reconstructs a deformable Gaussian scene from one event camera using event generation models and motion loss. No SNN computation is claimed.

pipeline_position: pretrained video super-resolution features plus events → lightweight alignment and fusion adapters → super-resolved video
abstract_basis: EATER adds lightweight event alignment and fusion units to a pretrained VSR model with parameter-efficient tuning. The adapted model is not described as an SNN.

pipeline_position: bi-temporal remote-sensing images → time-to-first-spike interpolation and SNN extractor → fused change map
abstract_basis: SpikeAdapter converts radiometric differences from two conventional remote-sensing phases into synthetic spike sequences for an SNN feature extractor. No event-camera or DVS sensor is identified.

pipeline_position: text description → semantic event generator and spatial motion synthesis → multi-human 3D scene
abstract_basis: The event generator decomposes a story into semantic motion events for 3D humans. Event-driven storytelling is unrelated to event cameras and SNNs.

pipeline_position: blurred image plus ordered event representation → recurrent motion extraction and bidirectional fusion → sharp image
abstract_basis: The method preserves event order through a new accumulation representation and fuses recurrent event motion features with image features for deblurring. No SNN is stated.

pipeline_position: RGB plus spike-camera streams → latent generative fusion → deblurred reconstructed or synthesized views
abstract_basis: SpikeGen explicitly uses spike cameras as its motion-sensitive modality and a latent generative framework. Spike-camera data do not establish the contrast-change event axis and no SNN is claimed.

pipeline_position: natural-language event logs → stochastic soft prompting of an LLM → forecast anomaly or imputation
abstract_basis: The asynchronous time series consists of irregular textual event descriptions processed by an LLM. It contains neither event-camera data nor SNN computation.

pipeline_position: distributed workers → asynchronous gradients and communication → optimized model
abstract_basis: The work proves complexity bounds for asynchronous distributed optimization and develops SGD methods. It is unrelated to event cameras and SNNs.

pipeline_position: heterogeneous distributed workers → asynchronous compressed communication → optimized model
abstract_basis: Shadowheart SGD addresses asynchronous computation and communication in distributed optimization. Neither event-camera sensing nor SNN computation appears.

pipeline_position: text sequence → asynchronously trained language-model mixture and prefix router → language prediction
abstract_basis: SMALLTALK LM trains a mixture of conventional language models with limited communication and routes each sequence to one expert. It has no event-camera or SNN axis.

pipeline_position: LiDAR RGB and event data → shared LiDAR features and multimodal calibration network → sensor extrinsics
abstract_basis: LiREC-Net jointly calibrates LiDAR RGB and event modalities and evaluates on DSEC among other datasets. It is a conventional learning-based network rather than an SNN.

pipeline_position: rare physics-event simulations → neural-process and Gaussian-process surrogate → detector design
abstract_basis: Rare events are low-probability physics backgrounds in neutrinoless double-beta-decay detector design. They are unrelated to event cameras and SNNs.

pipeline_position: static image → spike-form Q-K attention and hierarchical spiking embedding → class prediction
abstract_basis: QKFormer is a directly trained hierarchical Spiking Transformer evaluated on ImageNet and other unnamed mainstream datasets. The abstract provides no event-camera or DVS relation.

pipeline_position: ordinary streaming frames → future-frame prediction and statistical boundary test → semantic event boundaries
abstract_basis: On-GEBD detects semantic activity boundaries in ordinary video using predicted frames and adaptive thresholds. Neither event-camera input nor SNN computation is present.

pipeline_position: ANN teacher features across temporal masks → progressive distillation → timestep-flexible SNN predictions
abstract_basis: MEOM distills multiple temporal perspectives from an ANN and aligns truncated with full-length SNN predictions. No event-camera or DVS dataset is identified.

pipeline_position: event view plus intensity view → visual prompting and monocular-guided refinement → stereo disparity
abstract_basis: The framework aligns event-camera and frame representations to reuse pretrained image stereo models without event-domain training. No SNN computation is described.

pipeline_position: ordinary adjacent video frames → conditional diffusion → semantic event boundaries
abstract_basis: DiffGEBD detects diverse semantic boundaries in ordinary videos. These events are meaningful video segments rather than event-camera measurements and no SNN is involved.

pipeline_position: spike features → temporal shift and residual integration → SNN prediction
abstract_basis: TS-SNN adds a lightweight temporal-shift module to existing SNN architectures and evaluates only static image benchmarks. No event-camera or DVS relationship is visible.

pipeline_position: asynchronous events → gated recurrent spiking aggregation and multi-timescale fusion → detector features and boxes
abstract_basis: SDA uses recurrent spiking neurons to select and aggregate informative event-camera measurements before detection and is evaluated in fully spiking architectures on Gen1. The SNN mechanism directly forms the event interface.

pipeline_position: ordinary video frames → adaptive high-resolution region selection → precise semantic-event timestamps
abstract_basis: AdaSpot localizes semantic actions or events in frame-based sports videos. It contains neither event-camera input nor SNN computation.

pipeline_position: windowed event-camera data → learnable-timescale state-space model → object detections
abstract_basis: The proposed state-space model adapts event-camera processing across inference frequencies on Gen1 and 1 Mpx. State-space modeling is not spiking-neuron computation.

pipeline_position: event stream → continuous-coupled neural dynamics and wavelet analysis → conventional classifier
abstract_basis: The framework encodes contrast-change event streams with a continuous-coupled neural network and analyzes periodic/chaotic dynamics before conventional classification. CCNN is continuous rather than a discrete spiking-neuron SNN.

pipeline_position: low-resolution image → compact conditioned diffusion model → super-resolved image on mobile hardware
abstract_basis: Edge-SD-SR is a low-latency diffusion model for conventional image super-resolution on mobile hardware. It has no event-camera or SNN axis.

pipeline_position: audio video and text features → semantic graph alignment → audiovisual event label and interval
abstract_basis: AVEL concerns audible and visible semantic events in ordinary video and uses a graph network. It is unrelated to event cameras and SNNs.

pipeline_position: 3D point cloud → dynamic encoding and Spiking Mamba blocks → point-cloud prediction
abstract_basis: SPM is a Mamba-based SNN for conventional 3D point clouds with asymmetric SNN-ANN pretraining. No event-camera or DVS input is mentioned.

pipeline_position: planning states and actions → asynchronous LLM-agent reasoning → benchmark task completion
abstract_basis: Robotouille benchmarks parallel and sequential planning by LLM agents. Asynchronous task execution does not supply either an event-camera or SNN axis.

pipeline_position: blurred image plus event stream → learnable 3D Gaussian event aggregation and two-stage fusion → sharp image
abstract_basis: The method learns task-oriented Gaussian kernels over event-camera coordinates and fuses local and global motion features for deblurring. No SNN is stated.

pipeline_position: DVS binary images plus victim SNN → potential-dependent surrogate gradients and sparse perturbations → attacked predictions
abstract_basis: The attack is explicitly designed for SNN surrogate gradients and binary DVS images and is evaluated on CIFAR10DVS. It changes attack and analysis rather than the inference SNN.

pipeline_position: text prompts → asynchronous diffusion score distillation → generated 3D content
abstract_basis: Asynchronous Score Distillation shifts diffusion timesteps during text-to-3D training. It has no event-camera input or SNN computation.

pipeline_position: distributed training samples → asynchronous SGD analysis → stability and generalization bounds
abstract_basis: The paper derives generalization bounds for asynchronous stochastic gradient descent. Asynchrony is computational and unrelated to event cameras or SNNs.

pipeline_position: text prompt → Pasta-Lang asynchronous decoding interpreter → parallel language output
abstract_basis: Pasta-Lang parallelizes ordinary autoregressive language-model decoding and supplies an instruction dataset. It contains neither event-camera data nor SNN computation.

pipeline_position: brain-region activity and connectivity → spiking graph Transformer plus liquid-state module → diagnosis
abstract_basis: LGC-SGT uses spike-based global computation and a liquid-state local pathway for brain-disorder diagnosis. Its inputs are brain measurements rather than event-camera data.

pipeline_position: low-light image plus temporal-mapping events → illumination estimation and reflectance enhancement → enhanced image
abstract_basis: RetinEV converts event-camera timestamps under controlled transmittance modulation into illumination cues and contributes EvLowLight. No SNN computation is described.

pipeline_position: event frames/streams → BSA spiking self-attention backbone → event-based tracking boxes
abstract_basis: BSA replaces spiking self-attention with ternary bipolar interactions and Shiftmax, and its event-tracking evaluation uses FE108, FELT, and VisEvent event-camera data.

pipeline_position: time-series values → SNN temporal encoding and forecasting framework → future values
abstract_basis: The proposed SNN framework forecasts conventional time-series benchmarks and analyzes temporal dependencies. No event-camera or DVS relation is visible.

pipeline_position: event projections → analytical depth motion and directional expansion refinement → 3D motion
abstract_basis: The method derives optical flow and motion-in-depth from event-camera projections under contrast maximization. No SNN computation is claimed.

pipeline_position: stereo events plus sparse LiDAR depth → hallucinated missing events → dense stereo depth
abstract_basis: Sparse LiDAR hints are used to hallucinate absent events for stereo event-camera depth estimation. The fusion method does not use an SNN.

pipeline_position: image-text training trajectories → asynchronous matching and prototype mining → distilled multimodal dataset
abstract_basis: AMD asynchronously matches image and text optimization trajectories for dataset distillation. It is unrelated to event cameras and SNNs.

pipeline_position: pretrained ANN activations → sign-gradient neuronal dynamics → low-timestep converted SNN
abstract_basis: The work maps integrate-and-fire dynamics to subgradient optimization and introduces signGD neuronal dynamics for ANN-to-SNN conversion. No event-camera or DVS dataset is stated.

pipeline_position: raw event-camera stream → LIF Event Attention and event-aware state-space memory → recognition output
abstract_basis: FLAME uses LIF dynamics to extract multi-timescale features directly from asynchronous event-camera streams before structured memory processing. The spiking component forms the event interface.

pipeline_position: mixed medical finance or remote-sensing records → autoregressive Transformer and typed heads → next event attributes
abstract_basis: The events are heterogeneous records such as procedures and laboratory measurements modeled by a temporal point process. They are not event-camera data and no SNN is involved.

pipeline_position: event point cloud → sparse segmentation and correlation loss → tiny UAV detections
abstract_basis: EV-UAV supplies a large event-camera anti-UAV benchmark and EV-SpSegNet exploits motion curves in sparse event point clouds. Sparse segmentation is not an SNN.

pipeline_position: static or DVS input → temporal mutual-information regularization → robust SNN prediction
abstract_basis: TMI regularizes SNN temporal representations and is evaluated on DVS-CIFAR10 alongside static datasets. It changes robustness training rather than inference-network functionality.

pipeline_position: RGB frames plus asynchronous events → transient temporal and reliability-weighted fusion → point tracks
abstract_basis: TAPFormer continuously updates frame features with event-camera data and contributes a real frame-event tracking dataset. The Transformer is not described as spiking.

pipeline_position: UAV RGB event and LiDAR data → timestamp alignment and event-rendering supervision → reconstructed 3D scene
abstract_basis: SkyEvents provides multimodal UAV data and event-oriented alignment and rendering losses for 3D reconstruction. No SNN computation is stated.

pipeline_position: static task input or ANN → learnable multi-threshold dynamics and optional conversion → SNN prediction
abstract_basis: LM-HT dynamically regulates input current and membrane leakage and supports low-latency ANN-to-SNN conversion and hardware reparameterization. No event-camera or DVS evidence is given.

pipeline_position: event stream → event encoder aggregator and language adapter → generated description or reasoning answer
abstract_basis: EventGPT progressively aligns event-camera features with an LLM using synthetic and real instruction data and a new benchmark. No SNN is claimed.

abstract_basis: STAtten changes the inference attention of Spiking Transformers and is evaluated on CIFAR10-DVS and N-Caltech101 as well as static datasets. Event-camera relevance is benchmark-level.

pipeline_position: mesh tokens → asynchronous reinforcement-learning optimization → quadrilateral mesh
abstract_basis: Mesh-Pro uses asynchronous online reinforcement learning for 3D generation. It contains neither event-camera input nor SNN computation.

pipeline_position: multi-view spike-camera streams → dense initialization and spike-pixel constraints → dynamic Gaussian scene
abstract_basis: Spike4DGS uses photon-integrating spike-camera arrays and 4D Gaussian Splatting with new datasets. A spike camera is not automatically an event camera and no SNN is claimed.

pipeline_position: event-camera stream → path-selective aggregation and state-space scan → recognition output
abstract_basis: PASS adaptively aggregates event-camera streams and uses state-space models to generalize across event lengths and inference frequencies. It does not claim spiking-neuron computation.

pipeline_position: time-series values → dual-compartment TS-LIF dynamics → forecasts
abstract_basis: TS-LIF separates frequency processing across dendritic and somatic compartments for conventional time-series forecasting. No event-camera or DVS relationship is visible.

pipeline_position: information-extraction event structures → multi-hop questions and explanations → benchmark answers
abstract_basis: MEQA concerns semantic events extracted from text and evaluates language-model reasoning. It is unrelated to event cameras and SNNs.

pipeline_position: static or DVS input → quantized SNN under bit-budget allocation → predictions and energy analysis
abstract_basis: The paper relates SNN time steps to activation bit widths and proposes Bit Budget/S-ACE efficiency analysis, evaluated on static and neuromorphic datasets including DVS benchmarks. It does not introduce an event-specific inference module.

pipeline_position: pretrained Transformer → spatial and temporal approximation → converted event-driven SNN
abstract_basis: The method converts a pretrained CLIP Vision Transformer into an SNN with temporal-corrective attention for neuromorphic deployment. No event-camera or DVS data are identified.

pipeline_position: image features → localized charge-fire-reset attention → Spiking Transformer prediction
abstract_basis: LRF-Dyn approximates localized self-attention with spiking-neuron charge-fire-reset dynamics to reduce inference memory. The abstract provides no event-camera or DVS relation.

pipeline_position: noisy event-camera stream → event-by-event Transformer denoising → cleaned events
abstract_basis: EDformer models spatiotemporal correlations for event-camera denoising and ED24 supplies real noise data across illumination levels. The model is a Transformer rather than an SNN.

pipeline_position: long time-series patches → spike-domain Fourier selection → forecasts
abstract_basis: SpikF is an attention-free SNN that performs frequency selection on conventional long-term forecasting datasets. No event-camera or DVS input is stated.

pipeline_position: paired RGB and sparse events → dense-to-sparse feature distillation and consistency → monocular depth
abstract_basis: EventDAM distills RGB depth-foundation features into an event-domain model and enforces consistency across event sparsity levels. No SNN is described.

pipeline_position: ordinary image plus visual or language prompt → dense prompt fusion → segmentation mask
abstract_basis: SegNext provides low-latency prompted segmentation for conventional images. It contains neither event-camera data nor SNN computation.

pipeline_position: asynchronous dataflow graph → dual learned placement policies → device assignments
abstract_basis: DOPPLER assigns operations to devices in asynchronous computing systems. It is unrelated to event cameras and SNNs.

pipeline_position: LiDAR scans plus frame-camera context → 2D spatial temporal and cross-modal coding → compressed point clouds
abstract_basis: RangeCM compresses LiDAR point clouds using ordinary camera context and neural coding. Low latency does not establish either event-camera or SNN relevance.

pipeline_position: histology and gene profiles → prognostic slot decomposition → cancer survival prediction
abstract_basis: Structural prognostic events are latent biological patterns represented by slots. They are neither event-camera measurements nor spiking neural computation.

pipeline_position: event-camera coordinates and measurements → event-generation PDE-supervised implicit representation → intensity video

pipeline_position: low-light frames plus event streams → event-assisted Retinex 3D Gaussian model → normal-light radiance field
abstract_basis: eRetinexGS combines event-camera cues with Retinex decomposition inside a 3D Gaussian Splatting pipeline. No SNN computation is claimed.

pipeline_position: heterogeneous training batches → dominant singular gradient deflation → robust SNN

pipeline_position: paired RGB and event embeddings → pivotal-token feature distillation → adapted event segmentation model

pipeline_position: event camera plus coded optical mask → information-optimal PSF measurement → 3D point track
abstract_basis: CodedEvents derives localization limits and designs optical phase or amplitude masks for contrast-change event cameras. The implicit representation used for mask design is not an SNN.

pipeline_position: graph on a Riemannian manifold → manifold-valued spiking neurons → node prediction
abstract_basis: MSG defines spiking neurons on Riemannian manifolds and relates their dynamics to a manifold ODE solver on common graphs. No event-camera or DVS data are present.

pipeline_position: Markov-chain transitions → temporal-difference estimator → rare-event value estimate
abstract_basis: Rare events are low-probability transitions studied in reinforcement-learning policy evaluation. The work has no event-camera or SNN axis.

pipeline_position: task input → heterogeneous synaptic-current integration → SNN output
task_application: pattern generation speech and visual recognition
abstract_basis: HetSynLIF equips SNN synapses with distinct decay constants for multi-timescale temporal integration across non-event-camera tasks. No DVS dataset is named.

pipeline_position: static visual input → quantized spike-driven attention and information-enhanced LIF → prediction
abstract_basis: QSD-Transformer combines information-enhanced LIF dynamics with distillation to preserve quantized spiking attention on ImageNet. No event-camera or DVS relation is visible.

pipeline_position: event-camera stream plus frames → event-model motion optimization and refinement network → vibration and material estimates
abstract_basis: The method uses an event camera and its event-generation model for subtle-motion sensing, followed by neural refinement. No SNN computation is described.

pipeline_position: video and question → VLM plus video diffusion with Joint-GRPO → next-event video answer
abstract_basis: The events are semantic next actions in conventional videos. The model is a VLM–diffusion system, with neither contrast-change event-camera sensing nor SNN computation.

pipeline_position: event-camera edges plus images and LiDAR → aligned event-edge fusion → optical flow and scene flow
abstract_basis: Event-camera spatiotemporal edges define a shared latent space for RGB, LiDAR, and event fusion. No spiking-neuron or SNN computation is stated.

pipeline_position: event stream → online contrast-maximization learning on a drone → monocular depth and obstacle avoidance
task_application: monocular depth and drone obstacle avoidance
abstract_basis: The work performs self-supervised on-device learning from event-camera data using contrast maximization. It does not describe a spiking neural network.

pipeline_position: spike sequences → fixed-point parallel LIF training → trained SNN dynamics

pipeline_position: event sequence → adapted video diffusion with reinforcement alignment → future motion simulation
abstract_basis: The model adapts video diffusion to event-camera sequences and aligns generation trajectories with reinforcement learning. No SNN is described.

pipeline_position: blurred RGB plus event stream → event-assisted 3D-GS initialization and optimization → novel views
abstract_basis: Event streams from an event camera guide initialization and optimization of Gaussian splatting and support new datasets. No SNN computation is present.

pipeline_position: photon-arrival spike-camera stream → fluctuation-aware DSFT representation and feature alignment → reconstructed image
abstract_basis: The sensor is a photon-accumulating spike camera rather than a contrast-change event camera, and the reconstruction modules are not identified as an SNN.

pipeline_position: audio and conventional video → training-free score fusion and label-shift adjustment → semantic event labels
abstract_basis: Here event denotes semantic audio-visual categories in video. Dynamic thresholds adjust class distributions, not event-camera sensing or SNN firing.

pipeline_position: events plus frames → simplicial deformation model and neighborhood-greedy optimization → dense deformation fields
abstract_basis: Event-camera motion cues and image frames feed a model-based deformation optimizer and new benchmark. No SNN or spiking-neuron computation is claimed.

pipeline_position: static images → high-frequency-preserving spiking Transformer or ResNet → classification

pipeline_position: heterogeneous worker gradients → Ringleader asynchronous SGD → optimized model parameters
abstract_basis: Asynchrony refers to distributed gradient updates on heterogeneous devices. The work contains neither event-camera sensing nor SNN computation.

pipeline_position: offline trajectories → temporal and positional spike-driven Transformer → policy decisions

pipeline_position: low-light blurred RGB plus events → unified multimodal enhancement network → enhanced deblurred high-rate video

pipeline_position: low-light frames plus events → cross-modal temporal fusion and filtering → enhanced deblurred video
abstract_basis: The framework and hybrid-camera datasets jointly address low-light enhancement and deblurring with event-camera cues. No SNN is described.
